summary: Injured snowmobiler on Rabbit Ears Pass. An RCSAR snowmobile team drove nearly 30 miles to the Dumont Lake trailhead; given the severity of the patient's injuries, Classic Air Medical responded to the scene and flew the patient to a front-range hospital for treatment.
location: Rabbit Ears Pass, Dumont Lake trailhead
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue; Classic Air Medical
notes: RCSAR Far Routt Newsletter, Winter Edition (January 2024) — "3 Missions in 12 Hours" (mission 2 of 3).
